text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from an outing
with Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Here is fine.
—Today, I am going to learn... "Cutie."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san!
Over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry to keep you waiting.
Today... I'm counting on you.

It looks like the three of them are going out together.
However, Symboli Kris S is prone to being misunderstood in many ways...
choice_data_list: Would it be okay if I tagged along too?
Would it be okay if I tagged along too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Totally fine! Let's all go together♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Look, look, Curren-chan!
It's a new penー!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're right! So cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Could I use it as an everyday item too?
Or is the heart decoration a bit too flashy after all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's a little on the large side, but I think that gives it great impact, which is nice♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, matching it with this heart-shaped
pencil case would look so cute!
What do you think, Kris S-san?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't it hard to write
with all that decoration...?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! These decorations are the best part~♪
This is what "cute" is all aboutっ!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's all sparkly
and suuuuper cute, right♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............
――...It is difficult.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right here, right now!
Let's actually become "Cute"!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—Becoming... 'cute'...? 
——Me?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Experience is the best teacher♪
This is a totally "cute" Insta-worthy spot, you know!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Maya-chan, what pose should we do?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Let's do a heart pose!
Like this!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! Kris S-san,
you copy the heart pose too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Like... this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Waah~! Kris S-san is so cuuute~~☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hold it, hold it right there... okay, now!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...?
—Why are you taking photos?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because, because!
Both the pose and this spot are totally 'cute'!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“'Cute' is something meant
to be shared with everyone, after all♪”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You post the photos you took on Umastagram and stuff,
and everyone gets to enjoy the "cuteness" together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Sharing "Cutie."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—So that is the student 'standard.'
...Understood.”

Afterward, I thanked Curren Chan and Mayano Top Gun
before heading back home together with Symboli Kris S.
choice_data_list: What made you want to learn about being "cute"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“'Kawaii' is a culture—that originated in Japan.
—It has permeated—and is used by the younger generation.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: At the academy, too... I hear "cute" a lot. ...It is... indispensable... for communication.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "—I cannot bear... to hinder their interaction... out of my own ignorance."
She is truly earnest and hardworking. That's precisely why I can't help but worry about her...
choice_data_list: Let me know anytime you have trouble with Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —To learn and solve it on one's own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I want the Trainer
to fulfill their own responsibilities.”
Not easily relying on others shows her strong character, but that very trait made me worry about her all the more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――This must be it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Are you... not going to take a photo?

"Watching her strike a heart pose
only made me worry even more."
